# Sirach Chapter 32 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 32 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_032_page_001.jpg

---

32:1 Have they appointed you as master of the feast? Do not exalt yourself; be among them as one of them; take care of them and then take your seat.

32:2 And when you have fulfilled all your duties, take your reclining place, so that you may be glad on their account and receive a crown for your good management.

32:3 Speak, elder, for it is your right, but with sound knowledge, and do not interrupt the music.

32:4 Where there is entertainment, do not pour forth speech; display not your wisdom out of season.

32:5 Like a ruby seal on a setting of gold is a concert of music at a feast of wine.

32:6 Like an emerald seal in a gold setting is the sound of music with fine wine.

32:7 Speak, young man, if you must, yet scarcely, and only when you are asked twice.

32:8 Speak concisely; say much in few words; be as one who knows and yet also knows how to keep silent.

32:9 Among persons of rank do not act as an equal, and when another is talking, do not chatter on.

32:10 Lightning goes before thunder, and before a man of genuine character grace goes before him.

32:11 Rise at the right time and do not be the last; go home quickly and do not dawdle.

32:12 There enjoy yourself and do what your heart desires, but do not sin through proud speech.

32:13 For all these things bless your Maker, who intoxicates you with his good things.

32:14 Whoever fears the Lord will accept his correction, and those who rise early to seek him will obtain his approval.

32:15 Whoever seeks the law will be filled by it, but the hypocrite will stumble over it.

32:16 Those who fear the Lord will find right judgment, and they will kindle just acts like a lamp.

32:17 A sinful person turns aside reproof and finds a rationalization to suit his own will.

32:18 A sensible person will not disregard a misgiving, and a stranger and proud person will not shrink from fear when the time comes to act.

32:19 Do nothing without deliberation, and do not regret your actions after the fact.

32:20 Do not travel a way that is full of obstacles, and do not stumble over rocky ground.

32:21 Do not put confidence in a road with no apparent obstacles, and beware of your own children's ways.

32:22 In all your actions take care of yourself, for this also is keeping the commandments.

32:23 Whoever keeps the law keeps himself, and whoever trusts in the Lord will suffer no loss.

32:24 No evil will befall the one who fears the Lord, but in testing God will rescue him again and again.
